subject: world_language
concept: Reading and understanding a moderately complex authentic-style text (news-style article, short story) in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1 'understand texts on familiar matters' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with supporting visuals while reading a moderately complex target-language text
exercise.abstract: Student answers comprehension questions requiring inference, not just literal recall, about the text

misconception_flags: can answer literal recall questions but cannot make a reasonable inference from the text

interest_binding: text content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
